findings_and_qualified_questions.status: source-established selected-plan observation gap; actual capture and intended policy unproved
findings_and_qualified_questions.first_failed_contract: The dive-axis gate reports zero degrees when the selected stationary-dive plan contains no measurable travel direction, conflating unmeasured orientation with measured alignment.
findings_and_qualified_questions.reasoning: The four authored DiveForward/Backward/Left/Right posture-transition scenarios each plan 81 frames with local_direction Vec2::ZERO and zero speed. Their authored feature is Dive. Capture projects that zero direction through the finite zero-yaw controller rotation and normalize_or_zero into world_travel_direction. For these planned frames, the dive-axis iterator either skips an unstable axis or fails try_normalize on zero travel, so its zero-initialized maximum represents no angle; the current Dive gate nevertheless accepts a maximum <=20. The P17 90a metric instead produces Unavailable for no motion or stable axis, and its Dive gate requires a measured value.
findings_and_qualified_questions.qualification: This is source reasoning about selected planned frames if they reach report assembly; no viewer execution, measured axis, final report success or runtime observation is claimed. A stationary posture arc may intentionally have no travel; the owner must decide whether its axis gate is inapplicable or should compare with the actual authored dive direction. Existing complete-plan, finite-bone, other biomechanical and visual gates remain separate.
findings_and_qualified_questions.future_repair_direction: Preserve an explicit unmeasured/not-applicable distinction and resolve the stationary-arc direction contract using the real authored scenario identity; do not invent a launch vector or weaken moving-dive checks.
